text:
ashwin: FYI node gpu-rack-17/card3 came back from customer-return with intermittent ECC correctable deltas and a couple of Xid 61s during a short stress run. Putting it in quarantine for now.

maria: thanks. can we reproduce on our soak bench? last time the intermittent ones only showed up after ~12h with thermal cycling.

ashwin: agreed. proposal: 48h soak with alternating high-load and idle windows, plus periodic pci reset pattern. i want a run that replicates the thermal hysteresis.

devin: what exact commands? i can queue a job on soak-2 tonight.

ashwin: use this harness snippet:

```bash
# loop alternating mem stress and idle, run for 48h
for i in $(seq 1 144); do
  cuda_stress --duration 600 --pattern large_allocation || echo "stress fail $i" >> /var/log/soak-stress.log
  sleep 300
  nvidia-smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu,utilization.gpu --format=csv >> /var/log/gpu-temps.csv
  # pci reset every 3 cycles to trigger flakiness
  if (( i % 3 == 0 )); then
    sudo ./pci-reset.sh pci_slot_42 || echo "pci-reset fail $i" >> /var/log/pci-reset.log
  fi
done
```

maria: add `memtest-gpu --passes 2` after the 24h mark. and capture `nvidia-bug-report.sh` when ECC counters increase.

chris: noted. also capture kernel dmesg tail every 5m, filter Xid lines: `dmesg | grep -i xid` and push to the artifact store.

kevin: quick question — do we try different driver versions? i've seen one flaky card go away on 535 driver compared to 545. swapping drivers on soak bench is cheap.

ashwin: yes, let's run a driver sweep in parallel: 535, 540, 545. label runs with driver tag and rack/slot. we need to rule out software-level regressions before RMA.

qa-runner: enqueueing three runs on soak-2/3/4 with driver tags. each run will produce: `soak.log`, `gpu-telemetry.csv`, `pci-reset.log`, `bugreport.tgz`, `dmesg.xid`. i'll attach run IDs to INC-4231.

sre-bot: [automated] node gpu-rack-17/card3 quarantined by ashwin at 2026-03-18T02:25:21Z. Drain job created: DR-2026-1582.

maria: if after 48h we see ECC spikes correlate with thermal ramps -> try swapping the card into a known-good slot in same rack to check riser/slot/cable. do not yet ship back to customer.

devin: running now. initial smoke shows one correctable ECC count jump after 2h, capturing bugreport. attaching small sample logs to the ticket.

chris: when you see Xid 61 vs Xid 79 note the differences: 61 often points to compute engine timeouts, 79 tends to be driver/firmware. capture full Xid payload.

ashwin: decision: if failure reproduces within 24-48h on >=2 driver versions, escalate to RMA. if it's only with one driver/one slot, instead do targeted fw/driver rollback + follow-up 72h soak.

kevin: +1. also include power sequencing test: soft power cycle vs full host power. flaky risers sometimes only fail after full cycle.

maria: i'm adding a checklist to the ticket with the commands and artifact locations. inc-4231 now has the soak run plan.

qa-runner: update: soak-2 run started 1916508000, soak-3 run started 1916508060, soak-4 run started 1916508120. i'll post artifacts as they arrive. :thumbsup:

ashwin: good. keep realtime logs in the ticket, and flag if more than 5 correctable ECC hits per hour or any uncorrectable.

devin: will do. if anyone wants to watch the stream: https://artifacts.internal/soak/1916504321/stream

maria: thanks team. if it's intermittent and can't be repro'd after the full plan, we still keep in quarantine for a 2-week holding period before reintroducing to prod.

sre-bot: [automated] soak-2 job 1916508000: started.

ashwin: excellent. looping in fw team next if PCI resets + driver swaps don't isolate.

chris: saving commands here for quick paste: `sudo nvidia-bug-report.sh --logfile bugreport.tgz && scp bugreport.tgz artifact:/soak/1916504321/`

kevin: also capture SMART for NVMe on that host, weird power events can correlate.

maria: copied. i'll consolidate notes and close with a summary when runs finish.

ashwin: thanks all. followup in 48h or earlier if reproduces. :eyes:
